title: WATCH: Coffee tax floated as Gen Z turns away from alcohol

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A tax on coffee could be worth considering as more young consumers turn to coffee instead of alcoholic drinks, a representative of the Distilled Spirits Association of the Philippines (DSAP) said on Wednesday. During the House committee on ways and means on the proposed increase in excise taxes on alcoholic beverages, DSAP representative Olivia Limpe-Aw floated the idea of imposing an excise tax on coffee, citing changing consumption habits among Generation Z./dp READ: Tax hike on sugary drinks could raise up to P34B for PhilHealth – DOF...
